Authorized follow-up under Myk's autonomous receiving work. Independent P5 test audit and separate verifier found a coverage gap in T281/T282 at ee183a4: no valid competing law from another signer within a single authenticated source. This is a test-only correction, not a claim of broken production behavior. Do not modify T281/T282 frozen rails or source.

Add test/gateway/receive-source-author.test.ts using real signed claims and existing projectLiveReceiving. Use a receiver and distinct law authors A and B. Both publish valid law for the same hyperschema entity and reading; A at timestamp10, B at20. Fixture policies/gather bodies must produce distinguishable values over nonempty destination data. A binding selects sourceAuthor A, independent of authenticated source ID.

Acceptance, verified by npx vitest run test/gateway/receive-source-author.test.ts plus the unchanged three receiving suites:
1. Live selects A's exact registration ID and gather body and resolves A's literal value despite newer B law in the same source. A positive binding selecting B proves B's law is valid and actually distinct. Replay reverse order with duplicates agrees.
2. Exact one-time and paused selections containing A registration and newer B hyperschema/resolution definitions still select A's original definition and values. Include mixed-author manifests with valid version addresses; do not let wrong-address refusal mask author isolation.
3. A manifest selecting only valid B law refuses invalid-selection for one-time and pause while the binding names A. Controls selecting B under sourceAuthor B succeed. No foreign bytes are modified or removed.

Author this separate suite, measure green against unchanged implementation, and prove relevant deliberate author-filter mutations cause ASSERTION failures in an isolated clone. An already-correct behavior has no honest baseline behavior-red: record characterization and mutation sensitivity, not fabricated red evidence. Scope format/lint/typecheck and full isolated npm run check; preserve docs/LOAM_HANDOFF.md. Independent review before acceptance, Gemini3.8Flash distinct-provider review as authorized. Existing equivalent generated mutant remains a strict T282 gate limitation and is unrelated to this coverage correction. Freeze the new rail only after tests and mutation sensitivity are measured. No production integration, public export, new authority policy, or PR557 change.

MEASURED: Initial publication fixture omitted schema alg; 2 fixture errors and 47 passes, corrected alg before freeze. Final49focusedpassed (5new+44unchanged); unchanged source. New rail SHA256 9c25a54175f12e6d51a0003e29038c9d2ec6e7495bae57bce2cfe37d9cdcb060. Three deliberate mutations independently removed live registration author, snapshot registration author, and definition lawful-snapshot author filters. Each caused assertion failures under the new suite alone (no syntax/type failure claimed). Logs /tmp/loam-receiving-p5/t283-mutations.json. Independent rail reviewer accepted exact-address controls, literal values22/11/33, author/registration/gather identities, replay and byte retention.

AUTHORIZED RAIL CORRECTION: Independent second P5 test lens and independent verifier found that selected definition identities are computed separately from displayed law. A deliberate mutation removing author filtering only in definitionId survived all49currenttests at328543c. Strengthen the existing mixed-author fixtures before final acceptance: source-author strikes of selected hyperschema and exact resolution definition make paused law unavailable despite newer foreign definitions; lawful strike-of-strike restores; one-time stays fixed; source-author strikes of unselected foreign definitions preserve selected law. This coverage-preserving correction is within delegated autonomy and changes no T281/T282 rail or runtime. Record before/after mutation evidence and updated freeze hash; do not erase the earlier frozen checkpoint.

CORRECTION VERIFIED: All49focusedtests still pass. The definitionId-author omission that survived all49tests before correction now fails an assertion (selected vs unavailable); log /tmp/loam-receiving-p5/pin-mutant-after.log. Independent verifier confirms the specific gap closed and no introduced defect. Updated rail SHA256 7240e259de9b497dca67797aabc5ed0a63f0d006bff12de1311d713bd50d20b2. Full isolated check at prior328543c passed330files/3217tests with1file/5tests skipped; final test strengthening is validated separately and requires final exact full check before claiming it.
title: Prove receiving law stays within the selected source author
